policy.interpretation: Arithmetic regression goals only, not accuracy of observing utility or forecast probabilities
policy.missing_inputs: Planner missing airmass gets zero component; transit depth/brightness default to 0.5 with missing flags; weather numeric fields required; unresolved timing not eligible.
policy.rounding: Decimal half-even at one decimal; cases avoid ambiguous binary half-ties. Threshold-adjacent controls are separated by 0.001.
policy.sampling: Controlled score trajectories only; Mission 54 retains physical window-sampling limitations.
policy.schedule_objective: Sum of controlled per-slot scores minus stated synthetic switching penalty. Production ignores switching costs; expected regret is diagnostic, not a failed optimality contract.
